text_ja: 第一項の規定にかかわらず、次の各号に掲げるものについては、信用リスク・アセットの額を算出することを要しない。一中央清算機関に対するエクスポージャー又は間接清算参加者の直接清算参加者に対するエクスポージャーのうち、信用取引その他これに類する海外の取引及び現物・直物取引により生ずるもの二直接清算参加者の適格中央清算機関への担保の差入れ又は間接清算参加者の直接清算参加者を通じた適格中央清算機関への担保の差入れにより生ずるエクスポージャーのうち、適格中央清算機関以外の第三者において分別管理されており、かつ、適格中央清算機関に係る倒産手続又は外国における倒産手続と同種類の手続に伴う当該担保に対する損失の発生を防ぐために必要な方策が講ぜられているもの三資金清算機関等(資金決済に関する法律(平成二十一年法律第五十九号)第二条第二十四項に規定する資金清算機関その他これに類する者をいう。以下同じ。)に対するエクスポージャーのうち、資金清算機関等への預託金又は担保の差入れにより生ずるもの
text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (1), it is not necessary to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the following. (i) Exposures to central counterparties or exposures of indirect clearing participants to direct clearing participants that arise from margin lending and similar overseas transactions and spot transactions. (ii) Among exposures arising from the posting of collateral by direct clearing participants to qualified central counterparties or by indirect clearing participants to qualified central counterparties through direct clearing participants, those that are managed separately by a third party other than the qualified central counterparty and for which necessary measures have been taken to prevent losses to such collateral in connection with insolvency proceedings related to the qualified central counterparty or similar proceedings in a foreign jurisdiction. (iii) Among exposures to funds clearing organizations, etc. (meaning funds clearing organizations as provided in Article 2, paragraph (24) of the Payment Services Act (Act No. 59 of 2009) and other similar persons; the same applies hereinafter), those arising from deposits or collateral posted to funds clearing organizations, etc.

clauses_ja.text: 第一項の規定にかかわらず、次の各号に掲げるものについては、信用リスク・アセットの額を算出することを要しない。
一中央清算機関に対するエクスポージャー又は間接清算参加者の直接清算参加者に対するエクスポージャーのうち、信用取引その他これに類する海外の取引及び現物・直物取引により生ずるもの

clauses_en.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (1), it is not necessary to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the following.

(i) Exposures to central counterparties or exposures of indirect clearing participants to direct clearing participants that arise from margin lending and similar overseas transactions and spot transactions.

(ii) Among exposures arising from the posting of collateral by direct clearing participants to qualified central counterparties or by indirect clearing participants to qualified central counterparties through direct clearing participants, those that are managed separately by a third party other than the qualified central counterparty and for which necessary measures have been taken to prevent losses to such collateral in connection with insolvency proceedings related to the qualified central counterparty or similar proceedings in a foreign jurisdiction.

(iii) Among exposures to funds clearing organizations, etc. (meaning funds clearing organizations as provided in Article 2, paragraph (24) of the Payment Services Act (Act No. 59 of 2009) and other similar persons; the same applies hereinafter), those arising from deposits or collateral posted to funds clearing organizations, etc.
